definition: Asked on behalf of someone else (child, partner, parent, friend)
Said why they used AI instead of searching or a doctor (faster, cheaper, less embarrassing)

Told to see a doctor: the person's survey answers say the AI advised them to see a doctor or seek medical care (now, or if things got worse), including suggesting they book an appointment with a professional. Calling about care that is already planned (for example calling the hospital about a bed) does not count. Only the survey answers are used, not the chat text. Their own plan or view ("I needed to see a real doctor", "I still planned to speak with his doctor") does not count.
